verdict.rationale: The evidence shows code editing only inside Figma Make's own Files panel. Nothing documents a local-development workflow with your own editor, nor a way to sync or push changes back to the platform. Community evidence points the other way: Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, and a user had to reverse-engineer the binary format just to extract the React code, with no path described for pushing edits back.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work on the app locally with my own editor and tooling and push changes back to the platform
